```{r}
#Read in all RAND fat files from 2010 to 2020 to prepare for analyzing trajectories of totoal word recall
rand_files <- list(
  "hd10f6b.sas7bdat",
  "h12f3a.sas7bdat",
  "h14f2b.sas7bdat",
  "h16f2c.sas7bdat",
  "h18f2c.sas7bdat",
  "h20f1b.sas7bdat"
)

rand_years <- c(2010, 2012, 2014,2016, 2018, 2020)


rand_list <- lapply(seq_along(rand_files), function(i) {
  df <- read_sas(rand_files[[i]]) %>%
    rename_with(tolower) %>%
    mutate(hhidpn = str_pad(as.character(hhidpn), 9, pad = "0"))
  df
})


names(rand_list) <- paste0("rand_", rand_years)

list2env(rand_list, envir = .GlobalEnv)
```

```{r}
# Calculate 2010 Jorm score for proxy

rand_2010_proxy <- rand_2010 %>%
  filter(ma009_group == "proxy")

# Select Jorm variables (md506-md553)
suffixes <- paste0("d", 506:553)
vars_to_keep <- paste0("m", suffixes)

rand_2010_proxy <- rand_2010_proxy %>%
  select(hhidpn, all_of(vars_to_keep))

# Calculate Jorm score for each question
jorm_start_vars <- seq(506, 553, by = 3)

for (i in seq_along(jorm_start_vars)) {
  d_a <- paste0("md", jorm_start_vars[i])
  d_b <- paste0("md", jorm_start_vars[i] + 1)
  d_c <- paste0("md", jorm_start_vars[i] + 2)
  
  score_var <- paste0("j", i, "score")
  
  rand_2010_proxy <- rand_2010_proxy %>%
    mutate(
      !!score_var := case_when(
        .data[[d_a]] == 2 ~ 3,
        .data[[d_b]] == 1 ~ 1,
        .data[[d_b]] == 2 ~ 2,
        .data[[d_c]] == 4 ~ 4,
        .data[[d_c]] == 5 ~ 5,
        TRUE ~ NA
      )
    )
}

rand_2010_score_proxy <- rand_2010_proxy %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(jorm_score_2010 = round(
    mean(c_across(starts_with("j") & ends_with("score")), na.rm = TRUE), 3
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

# Remove individuals with missing Jorm scores
summary(rand_2010_score_proxy$jorm_score_2010)

rand_2010_score_proxy_clean <- rand_2010_score_proxy %>%
  filter(!is.na(jorm_score_2010))
```

######Calculate the proxy and self word total scores from 2012 to 2020######

```{r}
# 2012: na009  2014: oa009  2016: pa009  2018: qa009  2020: ra009
# Recode interview type for 2012-2020
years <- c(2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020)
var_names <- c("na009", "oa009", "pa009", "qa009", "ra009")

for (i in seq_along(years)) {
  year <- years[i]
  var <- var_names[i]
  group_var <- paste0(var, "_group")
  
  df <- get(paste0("rand_", year))
  
  cat("Year", year, "-", var, ":\n")
  print(table(df[[var]], exclude = NULL))
  cat("\n")
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      !!group_var := case_when(
        .data[[var]] == 1        ~ "self",
        .data[[var]] %in% c(2,3) ~ "proxy",
        TRUE ~ NA
      )
    )
  
  cat("Year", year, "-", group_var, ":\n")
  print(table(df[[group_var]], exclude = NULL))
  cat("\n")
  assign(paste0("rand_", year), df)
}

# Keep respondent only for each year
for (i in seq_along(years)) {
  year <- years[i]
  var <- var_names[i]
  group_var <- paste0(var, "_group")
  
  df <- get(paste0("rand_", year))
  df_filtered <- df %>% filter(.data[[group_var]] == "self")
  assign(paste0("rand_", year, "_respondent"), df_filtered)
}
```

```{r}
# 2012: nd174/nd184  2014: od174/od184  2016: pd174/pd184
# 2018: qd174/qd184  2020: rd174/rd184
prefixes <- c("n", "o", "p", "q", "r")

for (i in seq_along(years)) {
  year <- years[i]
  prefix <- prefixes[i]
  
  var_immediate <- paste0(prefix, "d174")
  var_delayed   <- paste0(prefix, "d184")
  
  df <- get(paste0("rand_", year, "_respondent"))
  
  cat("Year", year, "-", var_immediate, "summary:\n")
  print(summary(df[[var_immediate]]))
  cat("Year", year, "-", var_delayed, "summary:\n")
  print(summary(df[[var_delayed]]))
  
  df_clean <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var_immediate]]) & !is.na(.data[[var_delayed]]))
  
  assign(paste0("rand_", year, "_respondent_clean"), df_clean)
}

# Calculate word total score
for (i in seq_along(years)) {
  year <- years[i]
  prefix <- prefixes[i]
  
  var_immediate <- paste0(prefix, "d174")
  var_delayed   <- paste0(prefix, "d184")
  wordtot_var   <- paste0("wordtot_", year)
  
  df <- get(paste0("rand_", year, "_respondent_clean"))
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(!!wordtot_var := .data[[var_immediate]] + .data[[var_delayed]])
  
  assign(paste0("rand_", year, "_respondent_clean"), df)
}
```

###proxy: jorm score###

```{r}
# Filter proxy-only data for each year
for (i in seq_along(years)) {
  year <- years[i]
  var <- var_names[i]
  group_var <- paste0(var, "_group")
  
  df <- get(paste0("rand_", year))
  df_proxy <- df %>% filter(.data[[group_var]] == "proxy")
  assign(paste0("rand_", year, "_proxy"), df_proxy)
}

# Select Jorm variables for each year
jorm_start_vars <- seq(506, 553, by = 3)
suffixes <- paste0("d", 506:553)

for (i in seq_along(years)) {
  year <- years[i]
  prefix <- prefixes[i]
  
  vars_to_keep <- paste0(prefix, suffixes)
  
  df <- get(paste0("rand_", year, "_proxy"))
  vars_present <- intersect(vars_to_keep, names(df))
  df_selected <- df %>% select(hhidpn, all_of(vars_present))
  
  assign(paste0("rand_", year, "_proxy"), df_selected)
}

# Calculate Jorm score for each year
for (i in seq_along(years)) {
  year <- years[i]
  prefix <- prefixes[i]
  
  df <- get(paste0("rand_", year, "_proxy"))
  df_score <- df
  
  for (j in seq_along(jorm_start_vars)) {
    d_a <- paste0(prefix, "d", jorm_start_vars[j])
    d_b <- paste0(prefix, "d", jorm_start_vars[j] + 1)
    d_c <- paste0(prefix, "d", jorm_start_vars[j] + 2)
    
    score_var <- paste0("j", j, "score")
    
    df_score <- df_score %>%
      mutate(
        !!score_var := case_when(
          .data[[d_a]] == 2 ~ 3,
          .data[[d_b]] == 1 ~ 1,
          .data[[d_b]] == 2 ~ 2,
          .data[[d_c]] == 4 ~ 4,
          .data[[d_c]] == 5 ~ 5,
          TRUE ~ NA
        )
      )
  }
  
  score_var_name <- paste0("jorm_score_", year)
  
  df_score <- df_score %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      !!score_var_name := round(
        mean(c_across(starts_with("j") & ends_with("score")), na.rm = TRUE), 3
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  assign(paste0("rand_", year, "_score_proxy"), df_score)
}

# Check and clean missing Jorm scores
for (year in years) {
  df <- get(paste0("rand_", year, "_score_proxy"))
  score_var <- paste0("jorm_score_", year)
  
  cat("Summary of", score_var, ":\n")
  print(summary(df[[score_var]]))
  cat("\n")
  
  df_clean <- df %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[score_var]]))
  assign(paste0("rand_", year, "_score_proxy_clean"), df_clean)
}
```

```{r}
#Extract the age variables for the corresponding wave from the trkr file, check for any NAs, and then merge it with the score_proxy_clean dataset for that year.
for (i in seq_along(years)) {
  year <- years[i]
  prefix <- prefixes[i]
  
  age_var <- paste0(prefix, "age")
  
  trkr_filtered <- trkr %>% select(hhidpn, !!age_var)
  
  score_data <- get(paste0("rand_", year, "_score_proxy_clean"))
  
  merged_data <- score_data %>%
    left_join(trkr_filtered, by = "hhidpn")
  
  cat("Summary of", age_var, ":\n")
  print(summary(merged_data[[age_var]]))
  cat("\n")
  
  assign(paste0("rand_", year, "_score_proxy_clean"), merged_data)
}

# Center age at 75, rename Jorm variable, predict word total
for (i in seq_along(years)) {
  year <- years[i]
  prefix <- prefixes[i]
  
  age_var <- paste0(prefix, "age")
  
  df <- get(paste0("rand_", year, "_score_proxy_clean"))
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(age_centered_75 = .data[[age_var]] - 75)
  
  score_var <- paste0("jorm_score_", year)
  df <- df %>%
    rename(inf1jorm_score = !!score_var)
  
  pred_var <- paste0("pred_wordtot_", year)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(!!pred_var := predict(final_fit, newdata = df))
  
  assign(paste0("rand_", year, "_score_proxy_clean"), df)
}
```

```{r}
# Build wide dataset: start with baseline, left join each follow-up year

# Start with baseline
rand_respondent_all <- rand_2010_respondent_clean %>% 
  select(hhidpn, wordtot_2010, mage)

# Join respondent word totals for each follow-up year
for (yr in years_all) {
  df <- get(paste0("rand_", yr, "_respondent_clean_filtered"))
  wordtot_var <- paste0("wordtot_", yr)
  df_trimmed <- df %>% select(hhidpn, !!sym(wordtot_var))
  rand_respondent_all <- rand_respondent_all %>%
    left_join(df_trimmed, by = "hhidpn")
}

# Join proxy predicted word totals for each follow-up year
for (yr in years_all) {
  df <- get(paste0("rand_", yr, "_score_proxy_clean_filtered"))
  pred_col <- paste0("pred_wordtot_", yr)
  df_trimmed <- df %>% select(hhidpn, !!sym(pred_col))
  rand_respondent_all <- rand_respondent_all %>%
    left_join(df_trimmed, by = "hhidpn")
}

rand_respondent_all_proxy <- rand_respondent_all
```


```{r}
# Create all_yr columns:

for (yr in year_all) {
  word_col <- paste0("wordtot_", yr)
  pred_col <- paste0("pred_wordtot_", yr)
  all_col  <- paste0("all_", yr)
  
  rand_respondent_all_proxy[[all_col]] <- ifelse(
    !is.na(rand_respondent_all_proxy[[word_col]]),
    rand_respondent_all_proxy[[word_col]],
    rand_respondent_all_proxy[[pred_col]]
  )
}
```

```{r}
######IPW analyses#######

# IPW waves: 2012-2020
wave_years <- c(2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020)
wave_letters <- c("n", "o", "p", "q", "r")
wave_numbers <- c(11, 12, 13, 14, 15)

prepare_ipw_data <- function(year) {
  wave_letter <- wave_letters[which(wave_years == year)]
  wave_number <- wave_numbers[which(wave_years == year)]

  respondent_name <- paste0("rand_", year, "_respondent_clean_filtered")
  proxy_name      <- paste0("rand_", year, "_score_proxy_clean_filtered")
  rand_year_name  <- paste0("rand_", year)

  respondent <- get(respondent_name)
  proxy      <- get(proxy_name)
  rand_year  <- get(rand_year_name)

  rand_wordtot <- respondent %>%
    select(hhidpn, !!sym(paste0("wordtot_", year)))

  rand_pred_wordtot <- proxy %>%
    select(hhidpn, !!sym(paste0("pred_wordtot_", year)))

  rand_wordtot_all <- full_join(rand_wordtot, rand_pred_wordtot, by = "hhidpn")

  shlt_var <- paste0("r", wave_number, "shlt")
  adl_var  <- paste0("r", wave_number, "adl5a")
  iadl_var <- paste0("r", wave_number, "iadl5a")

  rand_filter <- rand %>%
    select(hhidpn, ragender, raedyrs, race_ethnicity,
           !!sym(shlt_var), !!sym(adl_var), !!sym(iadl_var))

  age_var     <- paste0(wave_letter, "age")
  trkr_filter <- trkr %>%
    select(hhidpn, age = !!sym(age_var))

  group_var <- paste0(wave_letter, "a009_group")

  ipw_data <- rand_wordtot_all %>%
    left_join(rand_filter, by = "hhidpn") %>%
    left_join(trkr_filter, by = "hhidpn") %>%
    left_join(
      rand_year %>% select(hhidpn, type_of_interview = !!sym(group_var)),
      by = "hhidpn"
    )

  ipw_data$race_ethnicityf <- factor(
    ipw_data$race_ethnicity,
    levels = c("Non-Hispanic White", "Non-Hispanic Black",
               "Hispanic", "Non-Hispanic Other")
  )
  ipw_data$ragenderf <- factor(ipw_data$ragender, 
                                levels = c(1,2), 
                                labels = c("Male","Female"))
  ipw_data$srh <- case_when(
    ipw_data[[shlt_var]] %in% c(4,5)   ~ 1,
    ipw_data[[shlt_var]] %in% c(1,2,3) ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA
  )
  ipw_data$srh <- factor(ipw_data$srh, levels = c(0,1),
                          labels = c("Excellent/very good/good", "Fair/poor"))

  assign(paste0("ipw_data_", year), ipw_data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  return(ipw_data)
}

lapply(wave_years, prepare_ipw_data)
```


```{r}
# Drop rows with missing covariates
drop_counts <- sapply(seq_along(wave_years), function(i) {
  year     <- wave_years[i]
  wave_num <- wave_numbers[i]

  df <- get(paste0("ipw_data_", year))

  vars <- c("age", "raedyrs", "race_ethnicityf", "ragenderf",
            paste0("r", wave_num, "shlt"),
            paste0("r", wave_num, "adl5a"),
            paste0("r", wave_num, "iadl5a"))

  sum(!complete.cases(df[, vars]))
})

drop_summary <- data.frame(year = wave_years, n_dropped = drop_counts)
print(drop_summary)

# Drop NA
for (i in seq_along(wave_years)) {
  year     <- wave_years[i]
  wave_num <- wave_numbers[i]

  df <- get(paste0("ipw_data_", year))

  vars_to_check <- c("age", "raedyrs", "race_ethnicityf", "ragenderf",
                     paste0("r", wave_num, "shlt"),
                     paste0("r", wave_num, "adl5a"),
                     paste0("r", wave_num, "iadl5a"))

  clean_df <- df %>% filter(complete.cases(across(all_of(vars_to_check))))
  assign(paste0("ipw_data_clean_", year), clean_df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}
```


```{r}
# Fit logistic regression for each year
for (i in seq_along(wave_years)) {
  year     <- wave_years[i]
  wave_num <- wave_numbers[i]

  df      <- get(paste0("ipw_data_clean_", year))
  adl_var  <- paste0("r", wave_num, "adl5a")
  iadl_var <- paste0("r", wave_num, "iadl5a")

  formula <- as.formula(paste0(
    "type_of_interview == 'self' ~ age + raedyrs + race_ethnicityf + ragenderf + srh + ",
    adl_var, " + ", iadl_var
  ))

  model <- glm(formula, data = df, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
  assign(paste0("ipw_model_", year), model, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

# Print model summaries
for (year in wave_years) {
  cat("======== Year:", year, "========\n")
  print(summary(get(paste0("ipw_model_", year))))
  cat("\n")
}
```


```{r}
# Compute IPW weights; calculate weighted means per year
for (i in seq_along(wave_years)) {
  year  <- wave_years[i]
  model <- get(paste0("ipw_model_", year))
  df    <- get(paste0("ipw_data_clean_", year))

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      p_probself = predict(model, type = "response"),
      ipw_weight = ifelse(type_of_interview == "self", 1 / p_probself, NA)
    )

  assign(paste0("ipw_data_clean_", year), df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

# Weighted means per year
weighted_means_df <- data.frame(year = integer(), 
                                 weighted_wordtotal_mean = numeric())

for (year in wave_years) {
  df <- get(paste0("ipw_data_clean_", year))
  result <- df %>%
    filter(type_of_interview == "self") %>%
    summarise(weighted_wordtotal_mean = weighted.mean(
      .data[[paste0("wordtot_", year)]],
      w = ipw_weight
    ))
  result$year <- year
  weighted_means_df <- bind_rows(weighted_means_df, result)
}

# Add 2010 baseline (weight = 1)
weighted_means_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(year = 2010, 
             weighted_wordtotal_mean = mean(rand_2010_respondent_clean$wordtot_2010, 
                                            na.rm = TRUE)),
  weighted_means_df
)

weighted_means_df <- weighted_means_df[order(weighted_means_df$year), ]
print(weighted_means_df)
```

```{r}
# --- Respondent only ---
rand_respondent_all_long <- rand_respondent_all %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("wordtot_"),
    names_to  = "year",
    names_prefix = "wordtot_",
    values_to = "wordtot"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year            = as.numeric(year),
    time_since_2010 = year - 2010
  ) %>%
  select(-starts_with("pred_wordtot_")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wordtot)) %>%
  arrange(hhidpn, year)

gee_respondent <- geeglm(
  wordtot ~ time_since_2010,
  id     = hhidpn,
  data   = rand_respondent_all_long,
  family = gaussian
)
summary(gee_respondent)
```

```{r}
for (yr in year_all) {
  df_name <- paste0("ipw_data_clean_", yr)
  df <- get(df_name)
  
  df_self <- df %>% filter(type_of_interview == "self")
  
  cat("Year:", yr, ":", nrow(df_self), "\n")
}


#Convert each of the ipw_data_clean_ datasets into long format and then merge them.
clean_list <- lapply(year_all, function(yr) {
  
  df <- get(paste0("ipw_data_clean_", yr))
  
  df %>%
    select(
      hhidpn,
      wordtot = !!sym(paste0("wordtot_", yr)),
      ipw_weight
    ) %>%
    mutate(year = yr)
})

ipw_long <- bind_rows(clean_list)%>%
  arrange(hhidpn,year)%>%
  mutate(
    time_since_2010 = year - 2010)

#Add the data for the year 2010
rand_2010_respondent_clean_long<-rand_2010_respondent_clean%>%
  select(hhidpn,wordtot_2010)%>%
  select(
    hhidpn,
    wordtot = wordtot_2010
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = 2010,time_since_2010 = 0,ipw_weight=1)


ipw_weights_data<-bind_rows(ipw_long,rand_2010_respondent_clean_long)%>%
  arrange(hhidpn,year)%>%
  filter(!is.na(wordtot))


#fit gee model
gee_respondent_weight<- geeglm(wordtot ~ time_since_2010, id = hhidpn, 
                              data = ipw_weights_data, weights=ipw_weight,
                        family = gaussian)

summary(gee_respondent_weight)
```

```{r}
get_ci_linear <- function(model, newdata) {
  pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdata)
  V    <- vcov(model)
  X    <- model.matrix(~ time_since_2010, data = newdata)
  se   <- sqrt(diag(X %*% V %*% t(X)))
  tibble(
    time_since_2010 = newdata$time_since_2010,
    pred  = pred,
    ci_lo = pred - 1.96 * se,
    ci_hi = pred + 1.96 * se
  )
}

newdata <- data.frame(time_since_2010 = seq(0, 10, by = 0.2))

ci_resp  <- get_ci_linear(gee_respondent,        newdata) %>% 
  mutate(type = "Respondent only")
ci_ipw   <- get_ci_linear(gee_respondent_weight, newdata) %>% 
  mutate(type = "Respondents only, with IPW")
ci_proxy <- get_ci_linear(gee_respondent_proxy,  newdata) %>% 
  mutate(type = "Respondents and cross-walked scores from proxies")

ci_combined <- bind_rows(ci_resp, ci_ipw, ci_proxy) %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c(
    "Respondent only",
    "Respondents only, with IPW",
    "Respondents and cross-walked scores from proxies"
  )))
```

```{r}
p_linear_ci <- ggplot(ci_combined,

  geom_line(aes(y = pred), size = 1.2) +
```
